status: PREDECLARED before any run, 2026-10-08, p6; requested by w2:pA (THEORIE_END_TO_END.md §1.1, Proposition 1). Exploratory mechanism probe, no OCR claim.
question: Inference-time refinement of a detector baseline by reading (no GT in the objective): does a Gaussian band (annealed or learned sigma) widen the capture radius of the CTC objective, and how does the radius scale with feature stride?
field: same analytic two-blob evidence as the T4 family; canvas 16 x 96, evidence_center_y 48
stride_construction: average-pool the stride-1 field by s (kernel=stride=s); FeatureFrame origin (s-1)/2, stride s; same band geometry in page pixels
reference_y: argmin of the tabulated point CTC for each stride (y*)

arms.annealed: minimize E_{N(mu,sigma_k^2)}[L]; sigma_k = sigma0*(sigma_end/sigma0)^(k/(steps-1)), sigma0 = 1.0h, sigma_end = 0.1h; mu only
arms.learned_with_detector_prior: minimize E_q[L] + KL(N(mu,sigma^2) || N(y_start, tau_det^2)) over mu and log sigma; sigma init 1.0h; tau_det = 1.0h (declared detector uncertainty, centred on the START, not on y*); log sigma clipped to [0.02h, 1.5h] after each step (support guard, declared before run)

capture_radius_definition: largest r such that every start offset in [-r, +r] (grid) captures; reported separately for the lower side and upper side

expectations_written_before_run.point_stride1: lower-side radius < 1.5h (half-reading trap near -1.4h known from the T4 profile family)
expectations_written_before_run.annealed_stride1: lower-side radius >= 1.5h (w2:pA predicts capture from about -1.58h with sigma0 = 1h)
expectations_written_before_run.learned_with_detector_prior: between point and annealed; the prior centred on the start limits capture to about tau_det
expectations_written_before_run.stride_effect: w2:pA Proposition 1: radius grows with the bilinear support; expect point radius to increase with stride (monotone in s), not fixed in advance numerically

interpretation_scope: one constructed smooth field, untrained features, no lexicon, no OCR or performance claim; capture here is refinement of an already nearby detector output, not recovery of missing lines (H1 remains excluded)
gaussian_truncation: +-6 sigma; any support exit is reported as status left_support, never clamped
